subject: general
question: In a circle with centre O, AC and BD are two chords. AC and BD meet at E, when produced. If AB is a diameter and ∠AEB = 36°, then the measure of ∠DOC is:
solution:
**Given:**

∠AEB = 36°

**Concept used:**

The sum of all angles on a straight line = 180°

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1f9815a72b520b1c67be037014a1229878996455c02e16a9112b92fe230d2dd.png] **

Suppose, AC = BD

Then, ∠CAO = ∠ACO = ∠OBD = ∠ODB

So, ∠CAO = ∠ACO = ∠OBD = ∠ODB = (180° - 36°)/2 = 72°

∴ ∠AOC = ∠BOD = 180° - (2 × 72°) = 180° - 144° = 36°

So, ∠DOC = 180° - ∠AOC - ∠BOD

= 180° - 36° - 36° = 108°

**∴ The measure of ∠DOC is 108°**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method:__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1f9815a72b520b1c67be037014a1229878996455c02e16a9112b92fe230d2dd.png] **

In ΔABE, E = 36∘ 

∴ ∠A + ∠B = 144∘ 

Let ∠A = a and ∠B = 144∘ - a

Now in ΔOAC and ΔOBD,

∠OAC = ∠OCA and ∠OBD = ∠ODB

∴ ∠AOC = 180∘ - 2a

∠BOD = 2a - 108∘ 

 ⇒ ∠AOC + ∠BOD + ∠DOC = 180∘

⇒ 180∘ - 2a + 2a - 108∘ + ∠DOC = 180∘ 

⇒ ∠DOC = 108∘
